step1.title: Tell us about your office
step1.explanation: Add your office name, address, and a few basic details so everything is labelled correctly.

step2.title: Add your branch offices
step2.explanation: Add your head office first, then add branches under it. You can pick which office each branch reports to.

step3.title: Set up departments
step3.explanation: Create the teams in your office so you can sort people and work by department.

step4.title: Invite your team
step4.explanation: Add the people who will use the system and choose what each person can do.

step5.title: Choose the parts you use
step5.explanation: Turn on only the parts you use — Finance, HR, Procurement. You can change this any time.

step6.title: Set your financial year and accounts
step6.explanation: Pick the financial year you're working in and set up the list of account heads money is recorded against.

step7.title: Set up leave rules
step7.explanation: Decide the kinds of leave and how many days each person gets, so leave requests work correctly.

step8.title: Set up pay structure
step8.explanation: Set the salary parts (basic, allowances, deductions) so payroll can be run correctly.
